summary.text: Julie Vossen-Henslin is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 16B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Dave Baker.
A small-business owner who earlier worked in healthcare administration and social services, she says her campaign focuses on local farmers, healthcare stability and economic growth.

paragraphs.text: Julie Vossen-Henslin graduated from MACCRAY High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota, Morris, in 1981.

In a Ballotpedia survey, her campaign said she was raised in a large family on a farm in Raymond and spent her early career in healthcare administration and social services in Willmar, working as a long-term care administrator and social worker.
The survey says she and her husband, Steve, launched and operate two local manufacturing businesses, Ductcap Products and KZ Sales.
The survey says she announced her candidacy on April 20, 2026, under the slogan "Real People, Real Change."

Among her listed priorities are agricultural fairness, small-business deregulation, healthcare stability, immigration reform, senior care, K-12 education funding, and tax relief and fair taxes on those making over a million dollars.
